marina_beach.name: Marina Beach
marina_beach.description: The world's second-longest natural urban beach, stretching 13 km along the Coromandel Coast with iconic memorials and vibrant evening promenades.
marina_beach.best_time_to_visit: November to February (Early mornings and evenings)

kapaleeshwarar_temple.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
kapaleeshwarar_temple.description: 7th-century Dravidian architectural masterpiece in Mylapore dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring an intricately sculpted rainbow gopuram and a sacred temple tank.

san_thome_basilica.name: San Thome Cathedral Basilica
san_thome_basilica.description: Historic Neo-Gothic Catholic cathedral built over the tomb of St. Thomas the Apostle, one of only three such basilicas in the world.

fort_st_george.name: Fort St. George & Museum
fort_st_george.description: The first English fortress constructed in India in 1644, housing the historic St. Mary's Church and the Fort Museum showcasing colonial weaponry and coins.

chennai_government_museum.name: Government Museum & National Art Gallery
chennai_government_museum.description: Established in 1851 at Egmore, it is India's second oldest museum, globally renowned for its world-class collection of Chola bronze sculptures including Nataraja.

valluvar_kottam.name: Valluvar Kottam
valluvar_kottam.description: Magnificent monument dedicated to the classical Tamil philosopher-poet Thiruvalluvar, featuring a 39-meter high stone temple chariot and all 1,330 Thirukkural verses inscribed.

guindy_national_park.name: Guindy National Park & Snake Park
guindy_national_park.description: One of the very few national parks situated within a major metropolis, sheltering blackbucks, spotted deer, jackals, and over 150 species of birds.

chennai_rail_museum.name: Chennai Rail Museum
chennai_rail_museum.description: Interactive museum in ICF Perambur showcasing vintage steam engines, royal inspection saloons, operational toy train rides, and Indian railway heritage.

elliots_beach.name: Elliot's Beach (Bessie Beach)
elliots_beach.description: Serene beach located at Besant Nagar named after Edward Elliot, home to the colonial Karl Schmidt Memorial and vibrant seaside eateries.

dakshinachitra_heritage_museum.name: DakshinaChitra Heritage Museum
dakshinachitra_heritage_museum.description: Living-history museum featuring 18 authentic transplanted heritage houses depicting the vernacular architecture, folk performing arts, and crafts of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.

parthasarathy_temple.name: Sri Parthasarathy Temple
parthasarathy_temple.description: 8th-century Pallava-era Divya Desam temple in Triplicane dedicated to Lord Krishna in his role as charioteer of Arjuna, showcasing exquisite stone pillars and inscriptions.

semmozhi_poonga.name: Semmozhi Poonga Botanical Garden
semmozhi_poonga.description: 20-acre urban botanical garden on Cathedral Road featuring over 500 species of exotic flora, bonsai collections, artificial duck ponds, and scenic pergolas.

vivekananda_house.name: Vivekananda House (Ice House)
vivekananda_house.description: Historic colonial structure originally built to store imported ice from Boston, where Swami Vivekananda stayed for nine historic days in February 1897.

connemara_public_library.name: Connemara Public Library
connemara_public_library.description: One of India's four National Depository Libraries, housed in a magnificent Indo-Saracenic hall with teak wood balconies and centuries-old literary treasures.

marundeeswarar_temple.name: Marundeeswarar Temple
marundeeswarar_temple.description: Ancient Shiva temple in Thiruvanmiyur revered since the 7th-century Nayanmars; Lord Shiva is worshipped here as Marundeeswarar (God of Medicines) for good health.

st_thomas_mount.name: St. Thomas Mount & Shrine
st_thomas_mount.description: Historic hill shrine where St. Thomas the Apostle achieved martyrdom in 72 AD, offering panoramic city and airport runway views along with the miraculous 'Bleeding Cross'.

arignar_anna_zoological_park.name: Arignar Anna Zoological Park (Vandalur Zoo)
arignar_anna_zoological_park.description: Spanning 602 hectares, it is one of the largest modern zoological parks in Southeast Asia, housing over 2,500 species with lion and deer safari drives.

birla_planetarium_chennai.name: B.M. Birla Planetarium & Science Centre
birla_planetarium_chennai.description: State-of-the-art 360-degree celestial projection dome and interactive science park featuring life-size dinosaur models, physics galleries, and space exhibits.

ripon_building.name: Ripon Building
ripon_building.description: Majestic all-white Neoclassical building constructed in 1913, serving as the headquarters of the Greater Chennai Corporation with its prominent 43-meter clock tower.

victoria_public_hall.name: Victoria Public Hall (Town Hall)
victoria_public_hall.description: Stunning Victorian Romanesque red-brick landmark built in 1888 to commemorate Queen Victoria's Golden Jubilee, renowned for historic theatrical performances.

anna_memorial.name: Arignar Anna & Kalaignar Memorials
anna_memorial.description: Prominent seaside memorials and landscaped gardens on Marina Beach honoring iconic Tamil Nadu leaders C.N. Annadurai and M. Karunanidhi.

mgr_memorial.name: M.G.R. & J. Jayalalithaa Memorials
mgr_memorial.description: Iconic memorial complex on Marina Beach featuring a soaring Pegasus monument and a Phoenix-shaped memorial dedicated to M.G. Ramachandran and J. Jayalalithaa.

chennai_high_court.name: Madras High Court
chennai_high_court.description: Constructed in 1892 in supreme Indo-Saracenic grandeur, it is one of the three High Courts in India established at the Presidency Towns and the world's second-largest judicial complex.

express_avenue_mall.name: Express Avenue Mall
express_avenue_mall.description: Premier shopping and lifestyle destination in Royapettah housing top global luxury fashion brands, South India's largest gaming arcade, and an eight-screen cinema.

phoenix_marketcity_chennai.name: Phoenix Marketcity & Palladium
phoenix_marketcity_chennai.description: Massive retail paradise in Velachery featuring luxury retail, IMAX multi-screen theatres, interactive family entertainment zones, and fine-dining restaurants.

t_nagar_shopping_district.name: T. Nagar (Pondy Bazaar & Ranganathan St)
t_nagar_shopping_district.description: The commercial heart of Chennai and India's highest revenue shopping hub, famed for authentic Kanjivaram silk sarees, gold jewellery, and bustling street shopping.

senate_house_university_of_madras.name: Senate House (University of Madras)
senate_house_university_of_madras.description: Architectural marvel on Marina promenade designed by Robert Chisholm in 1879, blending Byzantine, Indo-Saracenic, and Moorish architectural styles.

kalakshetra_foundation.name: Kalakshetra Foundation
kalakshetra_foundation.description: World-renowned academy for classical Bharatanatyam dance and Carnatic music, founded in 1936 by legendary Rukmini Devi Arundale amidst green groves.

vadapalani_andavar_temple.name: Vadapalani Andavar Temple
vadapalani_andavar_temple.description: Famed 19th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Murugan, attracting thousands of devotees daily and serving as one of the most auspicious wedding venues in Chennai.

chetpet_eco_park.name: Chetpet Eco Park & Lake
chetpet_eco_park.description: Urban wetland sanctuary featuring eco-friendly pedalo boating, licensed recreational angling, a 1.5 km walking track, and a lush butterfly garden.

music_academy_chennai.name: The Music Academy (Madras)
music_academy_chennai.description: The global epicenter of Carnatic classical music on TTK Road, home to the internationally acclaimed Madras December Music Season founded in 1928.

burma_bazaar.name: Burma Bazaar (Parry's Corner)
burma_bazaar.description: Historic trade market near Chennai Beach station established in the 1960s by Burmese Tamil repatriates, famous for electronics, perfumes, and Atho noodles.

theosophical_society_adyar.name: Theosophical Society International Headquarters
theosophical_society_adyar.description: 260-acre green peaceful retreat on the Adyar estuary, home to the legendary 450-year-old Adyar Banyan Tree covering over 40,000 sq ft, and shrines of all world religions.

covelong_beach.name: Covelong Beach (Kovalam)
covelong_beach.description: Picturesque fishing village and certified surfing destination on the East Coast Road, home to the historic 18th-century Dutch Fort ruins and water sports schools.

mylapore_sai_baba_temple.name: Mylapore Sai Baba Temple (All India Sai Samaj)
mylapore_sai_baba_temple.description: Spiritual sanctum founded in 1952 by devotee B.V. Narasimha Swamiji, featuring an eternal Dhuni lamp brought directly from Shirdi.

ashtalakshmi_temple.name: Ashtalakshmi Temple
ashtalakshmi_temple.description: Multi-tiered coastal temple on the shores of Elliot's Beach dedicated to the eight manifestations of Goddess Lakshmi, constructed in Omkar-shaped tiers.

annai_vailankanni_shrine.name: Annai Vailankanni Shrine
annai_vailankanni_shrine.description: Popular seaside pilgrimage shrine in Besant Nagar dedicated to Our Lady of Good Health (Mother Mary), known for its serene prayer atmosphere and ocean views.

madras_war_cemetery.name: Madras War Cemetery
madras_war_cemetery.description: Meticulously manicured Commonwealth War Graves memorial in Nandambakkam honoring 856 Commonwealth soldiers who gave their lives during World War II.

puzhal_lake.name: Puzhal Lake (Red Hills Reservoir)
puzhal_lake.description: Historic rainfed freshwater reservoir constructed in 1876, providing picturesque sunset views, quiet breeze, and serving as a crucial water lifeline for Chennai.

anna_centenary_library.name: Anna Centenary Library
anna_centenary_library.description: One of the largest libraries in South Asia spanning 9 floors and 3.75 lakh sq ft in Kotturpuram, featuring over 500,000 books, a hi-tech Braille section, and a dedicated children's globe floor.

muttukadu_boat_house.name: Muttukadu Boat House
muttukadu_boat_house.description: Scenic backwater lake facility operated by TTDC along East Coast Road, offering speed boating, water skiing, rowing, and serene pedalo rides.

marina_lighthouse.name: Chennai Marina Lighthouse
marina_lighthouse.description: Standing 46 meters tall, it is the only lighthouse in India within city limits equipped with a passenger elevator to a 10th-floor viewing gallery offering 360-degree ocean views.

anna_tower_park.name: Dr. Visvesvaraya Tower Park (Anna Nagar)
anna_tower_park.description: Sprawling 15-acre urban green park featuring a landmark 135-foot observation tower built for the 1968 World Trade Fair, amphitheatre, and tranquil duck pond.

kishkinta_theme_park.name: Kishkinta Amusement & Water Park
kishkinta_theme_park.description: Pioneering 120-acre themed amusement park near Tambaram featuring thrilling wave pools, water slides, flume rides, and 3D motion simulators.

vandalur_safari.name: Vandalur Lion & Deer Safari
vandalur_safari.description: Specialized open-wilderness safari inside Vandalur reserve, taking visitors on closed safety-caged coaches to observe Indian lions and herds of deer roaming freely.

spencer_plaza.name: Spencer Plaza (Mount Road)
spencer_plaza.description: Originally established in 1863 as India's oldest department store, this iconic multi-storey shopping plaza on Anna Salai is famous for Kashmiri handicrafts, leather goods, and gemstones.

armenian_church.name: Armenian Church of the Holy Virgin Mary
armenian_church.description: Built in 1712 in George Town, it is one of the oldest heritage churches in the Indian subcontinent, famous for its magnificent six-bell belfry cast in London.

luz_church.name: Church of Our Lady of Light (Luz Church)
luz_church.description: Constructed in 1516 by Portuguese mariners, it is the oldest surviving European church in Chennai, characterized by Gothic arches and gilded Baroque altars.

royapuram_railway_station.name: Royapuram Heritage Railway Station
royapuram_railway_station.description: Opened on 28 June 1856, it is the oldest functioning railway station in India and South Asia, adorned with classical Corinthian columns and Roman arches.

madras_crocodile_bank.name: Madras Crocodile Bank Trust
madras_crocodile_bank.description: World-famous herpetology research station and reptile zoo founded in 1976 by Romulus Whitaker, breeding over 2,000 adult crocodiles, alligators, gharials, and Komodo dragons.
